items.Sentence: The wastewater treatment process consists of influent screening, grit removal, primary clarification, activated sludge biological treatment (with Modified Ludzack -Ettinger process for nitrification/denitrification), secondary clarification, disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, and dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.

The Discharger thickens primary and secondary sludge with a gravity thickener, treats the combined sludge with anaerobic digestion to a Class B level, and dewaters the combined sludge with a centrifuge.

The treated effluent (disinfected and dechlorinated) is pumped through an effluent force main to Rodeo, where it is combined with Rodeo Sanitary District effluent and discharged through a deepwater outfall/diffuser to San Pablo Bay.
